digest.component_or_area: auto-lander bot credential and Gerrit ACL provisioning
propositions: The auto-lander bot's Gerrit HTTP token must be stored as an SSM SecureString parameter at /rebar/prod/autolander-gerrit-token within the existing IAM-granted /rebar/prod/* prefix, added via ssm.tf for_each set with fail-fast retrieval.

The token must be fetched by fetch-secrets.sh using get_param (not get_param_optional) and materialized into the shared .env as AUTOLANDER_GERRIT_TOKEN, distinct from the review-bot's GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN.

The auto-lander bot must be granted the Rebase access right on the rebar project's refs/heads/* in the project's own refs/meta/config (not All-Projects), enabling rebase-on-behalf-of-uploader functionality.
The bot's Submit permission is already satisfied by its membership in the Contributors group; no additional submit ACL grant is needed or should be added.

A read-only smoke-check-autolander.sh verification test must confirm token validity (auth), RebarBotNava membership in Contributors (submit eligibility), and presence of the rebase ACL grant, without creating or submitting changes.
